sections.name: File setup, positions, parcelRings, parcelFeature
sections.title: Shape helpers and feature wrapper
sections.what: Gathers all points from the parcel shape, returns the rings used for drawing, and wraps the shape as a labelled map feature marked as synthetic.
sections.why: Gives the map and the overlay one consistent view of the parcel shape.
sections.watch_out: Multi-part shapes are flattened, so the ring logic must stay in step with the shape type.

sections.name: parcelBounds
sections.title: Bounds helper
sections.what: Finds the smallest rectangle that contains all parcel points and returns its south-west and north-east corners.
sections.why: Lets the map zoom to fit the parcel.
sections.watch_out: An empty shape would give infinite values, so the input must always have points.

sections.name: parcelCameraOptions
sections.title: Camera framing helper
sections.what: Returns the padding around the parcel and the maximum zoom level. Padding is smaller on narrow screens.
sections.why: Keeps the parcel comfortably in view on both phones and large screens without changing any stored area numbers.
sections.watch_out: The comment states this only changes the view, not the area calculations, so keep it that way.

sections.name: createPublicBasemapStyle, MapLibreErrorEvent
sections.title: Basemap style
sections.what: Builds the map style with the OpenStreetMap raster tiles, a filled parcel layer in the given colour, and an outline layer. Needs no keys.
sections.why: Uses a public map source so the page works without a paid service account.
sections.watch_out: Each viewer's browser fetches tiles directly from the OpenStreetMap servers, so usage may be subject to that service's rules.

sections.name: isBackgroundTileFailure
sections.title: Background tile failure check
sections.what: Decides whether a map error is a real failure of the background tiles. Cancelled requests are ignored, and only errors from the background source count.
sections.why: Stops a normal page change from showing a false warning.
sections.watch_out: The check reads the error text, so a change in how the library words errors could change the result.

sections.name: ParcelMap
sections.title: Map component
sections.what: Starts the map in the browser, fits the view to the parcel, draws the overlay, updates it on moves, and shows loading, unavailable, or background unavailable messages. Removes the map when the component leaves the screen.
sections.why: Gives the owner a working map with a clear message when something fails.
sections.watch_out: The map is recreated whenever the geometry changes, so a changing shape causes a full reload of the map.

summary: Draws the parcel boundary on a real map background, fits the view to the parcel, and shows an outline overlay that follows the map as it moves.
purpose: Lets the owner see the parcel's place and shape on a familiar map.
why: Likely reason: a real map background gives context to the parcel. Reason partly stated in the test file comments about public and keyless sources.
how: Loads the map library only in the browser. Builds a basemap style with OpenStreetMap tiles and the parcel fill and outline. Once the style loads, adds the parcel data, fits the view to the parcel bounds, and draws an SVG overlay. The overlay updates when the map moves or resizes. Background tile errors set a warning, and failures to start the map show a fallback message. Cleanup removes the map when the component leaves the screen.
inputs: The parcel geometry, labels for loading, unavailable and background unavailable states, and the map colour from the page styles.
outputs: A figure with a map, a parcel outline overlay, and status messages.
risks: The map loads tiles from OpenStreetMap, so each viewer's browser contacts that outside service. If the service blocks requests, the warning appears. Overlay updates happen on move and resize events, so drawing during a drag may lag.
debug: If the map is blank, check the tile service and the browser console for tile errors. If the outline is misplaced, check the projection and the overlay update. If the map never loads, check the dynamic import and the geometry shape.
